text:
jamie: Quick syncI'm updating the tenant rehome SOC2 section. Need agreement on retention phrasing + a tiny SDK example for auditlog exports. Draft below.

jamie: Draft: "On tenant rehoming requests, Redwood streams tenant-scoped audit events as encrypted newline-delimited JSONL. Exports are retained encrypted for up to 30 days while in transit; extended retention can be arranged via SLA. Sensitive fields may be pseudonymized or redacted per customer configuration. For Private deployments, customers may manage KMS keys."

naren: Legal note: change to "up to 30 days unless otherwise agreed" and add how to request extended retention (support email + ticket). Also replace "may be pseudonymized" with "may be pseudonymized or redacted per customer configuration and in accordance with Redwood's data minimization procedures."

taylor: For docs UX: include a minimal curl + Python streaming snippet and a 1-line JSONL example. Keep it compact and link to streaming guide.

ashley: Eng note: export is NDJSON/JSONL streamed; ordering is preserved per-partition, not globally. Recommend using sequence_id + partition_id to resume. Also include Accept: application/jsonl header in examples.

jamie: Revised commit text ready?

taylor: Commit-ready copy:

"When a customer requests tenant rehoming, Redwood streams tenant-scoped audit events as encrypted newline-delimited JSONL. Exports are stored encrypted and retained for up to 30 days by default while in transit; customers may request extended retention via SLA (see support@redwood.ai). Sensitive fields may be pseudonymized or redacted per customer configuration and in accordance with Redwood's data minimization procedures. For Private deployments, customers can elect to manage KMS keys. See the Tenant Rehoming Playbook and Streaming Export reference for details and example SDK snippets. Ordering is preserved per-partition; consumers should not assume global ordering"

naren: LGTM from legal once support link is added.

docs-bot: PR #4021 opened against docs/soc2 with this wording and snippets. Please review.

jamie: Thanks all, merging once PR is green.
